page_title: MON 1-1 PAR | Monza v Parma 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.

90+3' A sweet pass finds Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Stefano Turati is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90+2' A clumsy foul by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle.
90+1' Keita Balde (Monza) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Hernani (Parma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
86' Kevin Zeroli goes off the pitch and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) comes on.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) for Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
80' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Alessandro Bianco is replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
80' Substitution. Stefan Lekovic (Monza) on for Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.

74' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Zion Suzuki pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
72' Here is a change. Samuele Birindelli is going off and Alessandro Nesta gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Ciurria (Monza).
72' It is time for a substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is on for Gaetano Castrovilli.
72' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
71' Christian Chivu has decided to make a change. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) replaces Pontus Almqvist.
69' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hernani (Parma) replaces Nahuel Estevez.
64' Christian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) replacing Dennis Man.
63' Substitution. Giovanni Leoni makes his way off the pitch and Botond Balogh (Parma) comes on as his replacement.

60' 1 - 0 Armando Izzo (Monza) blasts the ball into the top of the net after a well-executed corner kick deep into the box. Thanks to his strong and precise shot, the goalkeeper had no chance of stopping it.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monza.

58' Mandela Keita (Parma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Stefano Turati has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
54' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
52' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) sees a yellow card from Gianluca Manganiello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Armando Izzo (Monza) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is cleared to safety by the defence.

49' A neat pass is well received by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Parma will take a corner kick.
47' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes.

47' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Stefano Turati pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' A pass from Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is intercepted by Stefano Turati and the move breaks down.
44' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

43' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' The corner by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
39' Golden opportunity! Pontus Almqvist (Parma) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
38' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

34' Mandela Keita (Parma) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
30' Shots on target – 2:0.
28' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' The ball is laid off to Alessandro Bianco (Monza) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Zion Suzuki to make a decent save. Good work from Monza as they win a corner.
27' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) takes a short corner kick.
25' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) is adjudged offside.

23' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
21' Dany Mota (Monza) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
19' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
18' Dennis Man (Parma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Gianluca Manganiello saw the whole situation.
17' Dany Mota (Monza) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
14' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
14' Armando Izzo (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Manganiello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

12' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki pulls off a great save to deny him.
8' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
6' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
6' It looks like Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) saw red with that tackle. Gianluca Manganiello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
3' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Parma will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Gianluca Manganiello.
